selection: Before any pixel inspection, minimum target range among original-pose frames containing full missing ray segment (episode16) or full saved face (episode17). Episode18 checked in same episode16 frame. No depth/error criterion.

After nearest-view inspection, fixed supplemental rule: minimum optical-axis angle among all original frames containing full episode16 vertical segment, independent of image/depth values; no alternate if occluded. Third and final original frame.

sourceAssociation: Selected original/COLMAP-file poses/intrinsics exactly equal; documented model/level and author registration chain, with existing calibration uncertainty. Original evidence values unchanged.
projection: Original per-frame pinhole calibration; OpenGL C2W, negative Z forward; screen centres column+0.5,row+0.5; nearest original stored pixel, no interpolation
units: Published processed UInt16 depth export converted by author factor0.001 to nominal metres axial -Z; NOT raw native LiDAR measurements or independently validated metric accuracy
rawConfidenceLimits: No native raw ARKit depth/confidence, tracking, capture timestamps, measured RGB-depth alignment error or phone-to-FARO uncertainty bound available. Missing fields remain unknown; no confidence is fabricated.
referenceLimits: FARO reference is author-cleaned/hole-completed without a measured-versus-edited face mask. Missing support ray is not a proven physical drop; projected image content is not a semantic face label.

measuredDiagnosticRuns.scope: two bounded data-inspection scripts only; excludes earlier source-reading/metadata enumeration

correspondenceQualification: All pixel addresses and depths are conditional on documented frozen offline transforms. Raw OBJ is unaligned; source planner uses separately reviewed fixed-scale stage37 bridge. Pixel diagnostic uses saved original-model rays/FARO hit, not OBJ vertices. No independently established physical pixel-to-target correspondence.
